screen.label: quiz
screen.source: web_source/activity.js: quizEnter, renderQuestion, onOptionChosen, animateAdvance, onQuizFinished

interactiveElements.action: voice [sentence, word] of the current question

interactiveElements.guard: not locked, not busy, no overlay, paper not removed
questionSettled and not busy and no overlay

dynamicTexts.note: text variants collapsed into one element

flow: enter: hide all state elements, stars off, star 1 current, notes cleared, mute synced
renderQuestion: reset attempts, texts, papers restored, sticky cream, voice (prompt only on Q1)
answer correct: others hidden, paper to blank, pieces shown, sticky mint, star gold, next ready
answer wrong (1st): paper crumpled, sticky pink hint, papers reflowed, unlock
answer wrong (2nd): crumple, glow on correct paper, then correct flow with kind miss, star grey
next: box note, advance; after Q5 build summary and go to result
warnings: Sentence part 'after' (questions 2 and 5) has no text element in the manifest/build; only stem.before is shown.
Box notes: manifest has one slot per note kind; the code shows only the latest note kind. The source has 5 resting spots.

Rule pieces: the red strike on the dropped alef and the blue/red text colors inside the piece texts cannot be done in a plain text field. Prefix is shown with one kashida (the source measured how many fit).
Missed question: the correct paper is not tinted gray (source adds class act-gray).
Overlay elements (instructions, exit) are not in the quiz build. Overlay handlers are bound but inert until those elements exist on this frame.
ui.instructions.numbers in questions.json are '?' placeholders; code uses activityToArabicDigits(index+1) as the source does.
Keyboard shortcuts (1-3, Escape) and tap-to-skip are not ported.
Texts are set on the first text child of the MovieClip that the build creates for each text element (the build wraps text in clips).
Global logic uses root.createjs for sound; in Animate canvas createjs is a global, not a property of the timeline. Sound may be silent until fixed in logic_global.
